cosplay.character: the Chosen Undead in Elite Knight armour

cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: A private covered gallery with latticework looking onto a dock — She sits to enjoy the orange candies she made as a gift; An open-sided boat landing where a small ferry waits under the long roof — Lu Ji takes a break from her journey and shares the citrus she brought; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — carries her keepsake low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — types a message on a smartphone with both thumbs; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — holds a wedge of watermelon out toward the camera; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lying on her front; A passenger terminal’s private rehearsal room with a curved viewport — A dawn departure celebration is about to start; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — standing; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — sweeps the stones off a go board with black and white stones into their bowls; her living room with a deep sofa — seated on a chair; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — standing close to a high shelf or line
